groups.defect: bleveBackend.TotalDocs iterates b.cache without cacheMu, and the new TotalDocs call in searchSupport.init can race with BuildIndex writes from the just-started watch goroutine, causing a fatal concurrent map access.
groups.rationale: Both report the same unlocked map read racing with BuildIndex's cache write, one from the call site and one from the bleve side; both fix it by locking in TotalDocs.

groups.defect: NewResourceServer now runs Init synchronously and fails construction on any init error (blocking startup on the full index build), which also turns the existing bleve.New 'index path already exists' error on restart into a permanent boot failure.
groups.rationale: Both flag the same lines (258-262) because the new fatal Init in the constructor turns search-init errors into server construction failures. One reports this as a general contract change, the other names a concrete error that triggers it.
